name: Monster Breach - Pipeline Defense
description: 🧙‍♂️ Build real Fabric Data Pipelines to defeat the Corruption Horde. Each level teaches a Pipeline Activity. Defeat 8 bosses then face the Corruption King in a 10-activity mega-pipeline.
learning_objectives: Build Copy, Filter, Dataflow, Lookup, ForEach, If, Switch, Retry activities
Orchestrate multi-activity pipelines with error handling
Use Lakehouse as pipeline source and sink
Track real-time progress via Eventhouse + KQL dashboard
Validate pipeline output against expected results

items.name: MonsterBreach_LH
items.description: Holds dirty_crystals (input), clean_crystals_expected (oracle), and player output tables

items.name: MonsterBreach_EH
items.description: Telemetry for level completions, monsters slain, scores

items.name: MonsterBreach_Seed
items.description: Generates synthetic dirty + expected datasets for all 8 levels

items.name: MonsterBreach_Dashboard
items.description: KQL/Plotly dashboard: boss HP, crystals saved, leaderboard

items.name: Lvl01_CopyQuest
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds Copy Activity

items.name: Lvl02_FilterFortress
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds Dataflow with Distinct

items.name: Lvl03_SchemaShrine
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds schema mapping / cast

items.name: Lvl04_TriggerTower
items.description: Empty pipeline — player configures scheduled trigger

items.name: Lvl05_ForEachField
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds ForEach + parameters

items.name: Lvl06_IfMimicLair
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds If Condition + expressions

items.name: Lvl07_SwitchHydraDen
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds Switch Activity multi-branch

items.name: Lvl08_RetryReef
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds Retry policy + error handling

items.name: BossBattle_CorruptionKing
items.description: Empty mega-pipeline — player orchestrates ALL 10 activities (Copy + Filter + Dataflow + Lookup + ForEach + If + Switch + Retry + Notification + Validation) in one flow

post_deploy_steps: Run MonsterBreach_Seed notebook once to populate dirty_crystals + clean_crystals_expected tables
Open MonsterBreach_Judge notebook and read the Level 1 briefing
Open Lvl01_CopyQuest pipeline in Fabric UI and build it as instructed
Run the pipeline, then run judge.check_level(1) in the notebook
Watch MonsterBreach_Dashboard update with your progress
Advance through all 8 levels, then face the Corruption King in BossBattle_CorruptionKing
